question: In which of the following IOC Sessions was Thomas Bach re-elected as the President of the International Olympic Committee?
solution:
The correct answer is __**137th Session**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Thomas Bach was re-elected as president of the International Olympic Committee on **10 March 2021 in the 137th Session.**

 
 
• His second term as IOC President will start immediately after and will conclude in 2025.
 
• The** 67-year-old German received 93 yes and 1 no votes from the 94 valid votes.**
 
• Bach was chosen as the** IOC President for the first time on an eight-year term in 2013.**
 
• He served as **IOC Vice-President from 2000 to 2004, 2006 to 2010 and from 2010 until his election as IOC President in September 2013.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• International Olympic Committee:

 
 
• It was formed in June 1894.
 
• It was founded by Pierre de Coubertin and Demetrios Vikelas in 1894.
 
• It is Headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• It has currently 105 active members.
